The profile is done. I wrote the log to `work/exploration-log.md`. I couldn't run the record validator because `python3` isn't installed here, so the log is not validated.

# Northgate Clinic, January to June 2026

## Which account is Northgate
Northgate Clinic is two account IDs in the data:
- **ACC-1042** (Northgate Clinic) runs to 2026-03-31.
- **ACC-1077** (Northgate Health Partners, "formerly Northgate Clinic") starts 2026-04-01.

The only link between them is that "formerly" text in `accounts.csv`. I treated them as one account, and a lookup on "Northgate Clinic" alone misses April onward.

## Billing

| Month | Account | Plan | Units | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | 1042 | standard | 1,840 | $772.80 |
| Feb | no row | | | |
| Mar | 1042 | enterprise-annual | 1,910 | $592.10 |
| Apr | 1077 | enterprise-annual | 1,120 | $347.20 |
| May | 1077 | enterprise-annual | 1,085 | $336.35 |
| Jun | no row | | | |

The total billed in the extract is $2,048.45.

## Contract status
It was active in January, paused in February, and active in March, April and May. There is no June record for the account.

## Support tickets
There are 6 tickets, and none in February or June.
- **ACC-1042:**
  - 01-08, feature request
  - 03-11, feature request
  - 03-26, integration
- **ACC-1077:**
  - 04-01, billing question
  - 04-04, billing question
  - 05-25, outage report

## What changed, and when
- **February:** contract status went from active to paused, and there is no billing row for the month.
- **March:** status returned to active. The plan changed from standard to enterprise-annual, effective 03-01.
  - March billed $592.10 against $772.80 in January, even though units rose from 1,840 to 1,910.
- **April 1:** the account ID and name changed.
  - Billed units fell from 1,910 to 1,120 (-41%) and stayed near that level in May.
  - Two billing-question tickets were opened on 04-01 and 04-04.
- **June:** there is no billing row and no contract record.

I'm not attributing any of these changes to another. The plan change, the pause and the re-keying could each account for the amount and volume moves, and nothing here separates them. If you want one of them explained, that is a follow-up question.

## Data gaps
- **February billing gap:** it is consistent with the pause, because the contracts system (a separate source) shows "paused". The extract doesn't say what a pause means for billing.
- **June billing gap:** the other three accounts all have June billing, so the gap is specific to Northgate. Nothing in the data says whether it means no activity, an unrecorded bill or an incomplete export. Check that with the billing owner.
- **No June contract record:** the contract status file has no June rows for any account, so that gap is an export limit and not specific to Northgate.
- **Ticket completeness:** there is no independent ticket count, so I can't tell whether the months without tickets were quiet or incomplete.
